## Project Summary

**What it is:** Maple Row Physiotherapy appointment-request intake app. Patients submit requests (which staff confirm by phone from their practice-management system); staff review them at `/admin`. Python standard library only, runs offline, no external dependencies.

**Rules anyone working here must follow:**
- **Python stdlib-only** — clinic PC is locked down; no package installs, must pass tests offline
- **"Requests" not "bookings"** — patient-facing pages must never say appointment is confirmed or booked, only "Request received — we'll call you within one business day"
- **PHIPA privacy** — intake answers are personal health information under Ontario law; nothing leaves the server (no email, third-party services, outside scripts/fonts/analytics)
- **No payment collection yet** — parked until payment addendum signed; zero payment UI, card fields, or placeholders
- **Tests use fictional people only**
- **PREVIEW banner stays on every page** until privacy officer approval and release decision recorded

**Still owed before live (target date now open — October 5 is off):**
1. Dr. Anita Rao (privacy officer) must approve consent wording in writing
2. Clinic & owner set new go-live date
3. Review hosting/access controls (staff access, encryption, database protection, backups)
4. Decide abuse/rate-limiting strategy (not implemented yet)
5. Final clinic review using test data
6. Owner performs manual release and verifies on clinic system (no deploy script exists yet)
